heroTitle: Embark on a Spiritual Journey with Divine Precision
heroDescription: Learn Holy Quran recitation, Tajweed, Hifz, and Arabic language from native certified Arab tutors in private 1-on-1 virtual classrooms. Structured curriculums tailored perfectly for children, sisters, and busy professionals.
contactAddress: Altaf Colony, Ranjar Head Quarter, Lahore Cantt, Pakistan

courses.title: Noorani Qaida foundational phonetics
courses.description: Master Arabic alphabet pronunciation and connecting letters with classical Tajweed rules from the absolute ground up.

courses.title: Tajweed Intensive Recitation Excellence
courses.description: A comprehensive deep dive into the rules of Noon Sakinah, Meem Sakinah, Mudood (elongations), and advanced Makharij (letter origins).

courses.title: Quran Hifz & Memory Pathway
courses.description: Structured, private 1-on-1 memorization plans led by certified scholars to guide retention and rapid secure recall with classical revision loops.

whyUs.title: 1-on-1 Private Attention
whyUs.description: Every student receives custom focused lessons tailored specifically to their learning speed and mental retention.

testimonials.name: Kamil Al-Mansoori
testimonials.quote: My son's articulation has shifted beautifully in just 3 months. Outstanding tutors!

faqs.question: Do you offer female certified Quran tutors for children and sisters?
faqs.answer: Yes, we have a distinguished roster of female Arab scholars holding traditional Ijazah credentials, specialized in tutoring young children and private lessons for sisters.

faqs.question: How does the private 1-on-1 virtual classroom work?
faqs.answer: Each student receives dedicated 1-on-1 focus. We utilize interactive whiteboard tools, screen-sharing, and professional high-definition audio/video streams for seamless live learning.

blogPosts.title: Essential Tajweed Rules for Absolute Beginners
blogPosts.excerpt: Phonetics is the spiritual soul of Quranic recitation. Explore the foundational articulation points of Makharij and learn to read beautifully.

teachers.name: Sheikh Abdul Rahman
teachers.bio: Graduated from Jamia Naeemia Lahore. Holds high-ranking Ijazah in ten qira'at of the Quran.

comments.name: Sarah Ahmed
comments.message: Enroll Sarah into Noorani Qaida basic phonetics.

siteSettings.title: Truth Quran Academy
siteSettings.tagline: Uncompromising standards in Quran, Tajweed, and Hifz education
